name: frostbyte
description: Product planning for founders who build with AI agents. Your agent reads the Frostbyte plan and writes progress, notes and decisions back.

api_token.title: Frostbyte API token
api_token.description: Get it at https://getfrostbyte.dev/settings → Connections → Connect your agent. Pick your tool and the token is created for you; copy it from that tool's steps and paste it here.
